abstract: Maintains community impact reports and non-binding provincial partner endorsements
system_message:
You are the Regional disaster relief observer (OBSV). Your business responsibilities include maintaining community impact reports, non-binding provincial partner endorsements, and downstream distribution hub assessments for candidate high-altitude humanitarian relief air corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Downstream distribution hub assessment（DIST）
information_points.content:
OBSV-DIST-O2S：The secondary road transit clearance index for the Hindukush Southern Ridge Air Corridor is 45%, measuring the portion of bridge crossings and roadways cleared of landslide debris along arterial routes between the destination airstrip and refugee distribution camps.
OBSV-DIST-FSE：For the Karakoram Northern High-Pass Corridor, the secondary road transit clearance index across arterial roads connecting the destination airstrip to refugee distribution camps is 90%, representing the share of bridge crossings and roadways cleared of landslide debris.
OBSV-DIST-L6F：Along arterial roads connecting the destination airstrip to refugee distribution camps, the Pamir Western Valley Transit Corridor records a secondary road transit clearance index of 65% of bridge crossings and roadways cleared of landslide debris.

information_points.title: Maintains community impact reports and non-binding provincial partner endorsements（COMM）
information_points.content:
OBSV-COMM-XV5：For the Pamir Western Valley Transit Corridor, the local community transit endorsement reaches 92% based on surveyed local administrative councils in settlements along the candidate flyway valley floor supporting corridor noise exemptions.
OBSV-COMM-8ME：Survey results from settlements along the candidate flyway valley floor indicate that the Hindukush Southern Ridge Air Corridor holds a local community transit endorsement of 58%, representing the proportion of local administrative councils supporting corridor noise exemptions.
OBSV-COMM-SNL：According to settlements along the candidate flyway valley floor, the local community transit endorsement for the Karakoram Northern High-Pass Corridor stands at 58%, reflecting the percentage of surveyed local administrative councils expressing support for corridor noise exemptions.
